description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Annual Improvements to SLFRs 2016 effective from 01st January 2017/2018 (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the publication of amendments to accounting standards (SLFRS 1, SLFRS 12, and LKAS 28) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework modifications and compliance requirements for financial reporting, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
